latestRoutes.title: How Founder weekly reviews with AI

clusters.name: Execution
clusters.description: Make plans real: containers, anti-procrastination mechanics, sequencing, and shipping under imperfect conditions.

clusters.name: Systems
clusters.description: Operating systems for your life and business: templates, checklists, decision trees, and maintenance cadences.

clusters.name: Discipline
clusters.description: Consistent action without self-hate: habit scaffolding, relapse-proofing, and friction engineering that make the right action the easy one on a bad day.

clusters.name: Identity
clusters.description: Self-concept that supports execution: confidence, boundaries, fear, and rewriting the story you act from, so what you do matches who you mean to be.

clusters.name: Leverage
clusters.description: Compounding advantage: delegation, automation, writing, distribution, and systems that scale your impact without scaling your hours at the same rate.

clusters.name: Executive Operating System
clusters.description: Time blocks, meeting hygiene, weekly planning, and the repeatable routines that keep an executive calendar sane when every week brings new demands.

clusters.name: Wealth
clusters.description: Money systems: offers, pricing, compounding habits, and practical strategy for earning more and keeping it, without treating every day as a hustle.

clusters.name: Accountability
clusters.description: Keeping promises to yourself: tracking, review loops, and honest feedback without spiraling, so a missed commitment becomes data instead of a reason to quit.

clusters.name: Systems & Decisions
clusters.description: Decision quality: frameworks, tradeoffs, risk management, and how to pick the right next move fast when the inputs are fuzzy and the stakes are real.

clusters.name: Burnout & Recovery
clusters.description: Protect energy and rebuild capacity: boundaries, recovery protocols, and sustainable performance for people who have been running on empty for too long.
